mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeout_task (task_type, biz_id, action_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{bizId}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delaySeconds}, NOW()), TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delaySeconds}, NOW()), #{status}, #{retryCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE timeout_task SET status = 'WAITING', action_time = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delaySeconds}, NOW()), next_fire_time = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delaySeconds}, NOW()), retry_count = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED')
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, biz_id, action_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at FROM timeout_task WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'RETRYING') AND next_fire_time <= #{dueBefore} ORDER BY next_fire_time LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE timeout_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND biz_id IN #{bizId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RETRYING')

UPDATE timeout_task SET status = 'RETRYING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_fire_time = CASE WHEN biz_id = #{bizId} THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{backoffSeconds[${i}]}, NOW()) ELSE next_fire_time END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND biz_id IN #{bizId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RETRYING')
UPDATE timeout_task SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND biz_id IN #{bizId} AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RETRYING')
UPDATE timeout_task SET status = 'RETRYING', retry_count = 0, next_fire_time = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_type = #{taskType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} AND status = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, biz_id, action_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at FROM timeout_task WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeout_task WHERE status = 'FAILED'
